meta.title: Style guide
meta.description: Colours, type and components for the Friends of Animals site. Test sites only.

styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.lead: The parts this site is built from, each in its finished form. Copy from here, and keep one radius, one shadow and one voice.

colour.lead: Six hues from the logo and its mixes, on warm paper. Step 700 and darker is safe for text on paper. Meaning never rides on colour alone.

type.intro: Baloo 2 for headings, numbers and rupees; Inter for reading; Kalam for a few handwritten words. Headings grow smoothly from 360 to 1280 pixels wide.
type.lead: A short first line that a child can read, with the detail after it.
type.body: Body text is 18 pixels with a measure of no more than 68 characters, so a line is easy to follow from start to end.
type.small: Small text, for captions and credits.

primitives.calloutBody: One idea per box, with an icon and a word as well as a colour.
primitives.disclosureBody: Native details element: no JavaScript, keyboard ready. Give a group the same name to open one at a time.
primitives.headingLead: An eyebrow led by a tile, the heading, and one lead line.

dark.lead: The same parts in the dark theme: warm ink-black, never pure black, with the white logo.
